failure_modes: If a temporal_teacher blend were applied, the observed-node sign flips in landmark local displacement could be tracked as a coordinate reward, displacing surrounding coordinates without any affinity-head signal, since the endpoint VJP carries no affinity derivative and no observed affinity outcome is available to validate the change.

If teacher_neighbors were narrowed or broadened, mode coverage of the detached teacher mixture would shift; with only nominally significant shape contrasts and null centroid contrasts, the change could suppress the reproducible shape direction or amplify an unreplicated one, and neighbor count is not a distance bandwidth.

If pointcloud_delta_A were reduced, the robust kernel would behave more like squared distance and increase sensitivity to outlier endpoint coordinates, producing unnecessary displacement of surrounding coordinates under the max_atom_step_A and cumulative RMS constraints without evidence of affinity gain.
rationale: Objective is affinity-primary with coordinate control only, and the label prior is equal with recorded affinities removed, so no observed affinity outcome exists to score any coordinate rule against (Eaa4bda02c9a2c3a1, E0857891f4effbfe1). H001's time-conditioned contrast rests on observed-node linear fits whose endpoint rates are unstable and whose extrapolation is disallowed (E2e106e083189d150, Eace79c1f0f54c9d1, E03ad082bb04f4f9c, E894225fb605458cb); a temporal derivative is not a coordinate gradient, so the registered temporal_teacher/temporal_region recipes would change teacher coordinates or regional attention without a demonstrated affinity benefit. H002's shape_xx/shape_yy contrast is only nominally significant (q>0.15) with same-sign batch fraction ~0.79, while global centroid contrasts are null (Ed061d96cc23b359b, E8059a7206f447cdc, E887f2d11255b77af, E455d8ea90d2c10e1, Ec3d5c7e8cb8584c5). The incumbent already uses teacher_neighbors=4, pointcloud_delta_A=1.0, mixture_temperature=0.5 and teacher_endpoint_temperature_A2=4.0; offered choices C001-C003 (delta), C005-C007 (neighbor count) and C009-C011 (temporal blend) would alter dose, neighborhood breadth or teacher coordinates without a defensible expected advantage, and C004/C008 (region index) are not supported by any read regional evidence. Retaining the incumbent is therefore the evidence-supported decision; temperatures remain fixed and untouched.
